# National Alliance on Mental Illness (NAMI)

> NAMI is the nation's largest mental health advocacy organization providing free peer support, resources, and local community networks to help individuals and families affected by mental illness.

NAMI operates as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit with headquarters in Arlington, VA, and maintains a network of 700+ state organizations and affiliates across the United States. The organization offers multilingual support services including the NAMI HelpLine, specialized helplines for teens/young adults and family caregivers, and comprehensive mental health education and advocacy programs.

- Mental Health Advocacy

## Peer Support & HelpLines

- [NAMI HelpLine](https://www.nami.org/nami-helpline): Free nationwide peer-support helpline for mental health support
- [Teen & Young Adult HelpLine](https://www.nami.org/nami-helpline/teen-young-adult-helpline): Free peer-support helpline for teens and young adults
- [Family Caregiver HelpLine](https://www.nami.org/nami-helpline/family-caregiver-helpline): Support and resources for family members and caregivers
- [Línea de ayuda de NAMI](https://www.nami.org/nami-helpline/linea-de-ayuda-de-nami): Spanish-language mental health helpline and support services
- [NAMI HelpLine FAQs](https://helplinefaqs.nami.org): FAQs and resources for NAMI HelpLine services
- [The Heart of the NAMI HelpLine: Volunteers](https://www.nami.org/nami-helpline/the-heart-of-the-nami-helpline-volunteers): Stories of NAMI HelpLine volunteers and their impact

## Get Involved & Community

- [National Alliance on Mental Illness (NAMI)](https://www.nami.org): NAMI homepage: nation's largest mental health advocacy organization
- [Join NAMI](https://my.nami.org/join-nami): NAMI membership signup and account creation page
- [Stay Connected](https://www.nami.org/stay-connected): Hub for community connection, local chapters, and support networks
- [Find Your Local NAMI](https://www.nami.org/find-your-local-nami): Directory to find local NAMI chapters and support programs
- [Find Your Local NAMI (Directory)](https://www.nami.org/findsupport): Locate 700+ NAMI State Organizations and Affiliates nationwide

## Mental Health Resources & Guides

- [Living With a Mental Health Condition](https://www.nami.org/living-with-a-mental-health-condition): Guide to living with mental health conditions and finding support
- [Finding a Mental Health Professional](https://www.nami.org/living-with-a-mental-health-condition/finding-a-mental-health-professional): Guide to finding and selecting mental health professionals
- [Understanding Health Insurance](https://www.nami.org/living-with-a-mental-health-condition/understanding-health-insurance): Guide to health insurance coverage for mental health treatment
